title: CTest test-list shards need build-root-relative path normalization
body: run-tests-split.sh generated valid shard-N.tests files under a relative --out directory but passed the relative path to CTest; CTest resolved it under --test-dir and every GPU shard failed before execution. The runner had to realpath each list before forwarding it. Consolidate path normalization at the CTest selection/runner boundary.
